entities.summary: Cultivation System, a pivotal event in the history of Indonesia (1800–1870). Part of Dutch East Indies Colonial State. This led to Java War — Prince Diponegoro's rebellion against Dutch rule and Cultivation System forces Javanese peasants into compulsory crop production.
